name: FunctionGemma chat demos en zh
command:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@raspberrypi.tailf63b31.ts.net 'cd ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm && /home/luigi/pulsar-rpi/v/bin/python -u -c "open("/tmp/fc_hello.txt","w").write("<bos><start_of_turn>user
Hello<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
")" && /home/luigi/pulsar-rpi/v/bin/python -u -c "open("/tmp/fc_nihao.txt","w").write("<bos><start_of_turn>user
\xe4\xbd\xa0\xe5\xa5\xbd\xef\xbc\x81<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
")" && cd asm && S=$(echo ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--google--functiongemma-270m-it/snapshots/*/model.safetensors) && timeout 150 ./core $S ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/fcvocab.bin 2 f ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/fcbpe.bin 1000 950 48 < /tmp/fc_hello.txt > /tmp/fc_hello.log 2>&1; echo EN-EXIT=$?; timeout 150 ./core $S ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/fcvocab.bin 2 f ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/fcbpe.bin 1000 950 48 < /tmp/fc_nihao.txt > /tmp/fc_nihao.log 2>&1; echo ZH-EXIT=$?; echo "== EN:"; tail -6 /tmp/fc_hello.log | cut -c1-55; echo "== ZH:"; tail -6 /tmp/fc_nihao.log | cut -c1-55'
